title: Paused-queue and retained cards: an Engram hold preview without resume or cancel wording gets no next-step hint
outcome: An 'Engram…' preview that the cards classify as an Engram hold, but that carries no resume or cancel wording, still gets a correct next step: either a resume/cancel hint, or, where the backend retries it on its own (the source-observation withheld preview), automatic-retry wording.
acceptance: Paused-queue and retained cards: an Engram hold preview without resume or cancel wording gets no next-step hint is done
